The '''Echo''' was a model of [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bike]] produced by [[Praxon]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].<ref name="TOR" />
